fields.help_en: The ARN of the role for cross-account delivery. This parameter is required when EndpointType is set to queue and EndpointValue is set to the ARN of a cross-account queue, which means the account that owns the queue is different from the current account. Format: acs:ram::<UID of the account that owns the queue>:role/<Role name>. The role must be created by the account that owns the queue. The trust policy must allow the delivery account to assume the role, and the role must be granted permissions to send messages to the destination queue
fields.help_zh: 跨账号投递角色 ARN。当 EndpointType 为 queue 且 EndpointValue 为跨账号队列 ARN（队列归属账号与当前账号不同）时必填，格式：acs:ram::<队列归属账号UID>:role/<角色名>；该角色需由队列归属账号创建，信任策略允许投递方账号扮演，并授予向目标队列发送消息的权限
fields.name: endpoint_role_name

fields.help_en:
The endpoint type. Valid values:

topic: Topic type. Topics support delivery to multiple subscription endpoints. You can add or remove subscription endpoints later.
queue: Queue type. Messages are delivered directly to the queue. This reduces the routing path, but you cannot add new subscription endpoints later
fields.help_zh:
接入点类型。取值：

topic：  主题类型。主题支持投递到多个订阅接收端。后续也可以增加或删除订阅接收端。
queue： 队列类型。直接投递到队列。可以减少链路路径，但后续不可增加新的订阅接收端
fields.name: endpoint_type

fields.help_en: The actual value of the endpoint. If EndpointType is set to topic, this parameter specifies the topic name. If EndpointType is set to queue, this parameter specifies the queue name
fields.help_zh: 接收终端实际值。当 EndpointType=topic 时为 Topic 名称，当 EndpointType=queue 时为 Queue 名称
fields.name: endpoint_value

parameters.help_en: The endpoint that receives messages for this subscription
